problem: Every dashboard number is fabricated: revenue "$245,800 +12.5%", 47 orders, 94.2% efficiency, 6.8x turnover, chart bars and financial summary are literals.
evidence: smarterpfrontend/src/components/Dashboard/Dashboard.js:33-58, 70-75, 88-111, 124-148; reportsAPI.getDashboard (services/api.js) never called
impact: Management makes decisions on numbers that never change and are not the company's data.
root_cause: Dashboard was built as a visual mock-up and never wired to report-service.
fix: Render /api/reports/dashboard (already returns real KPIs, verified RT-042..044); remove all literal figures; show "no data yet" when empty.

module: Orders, Inventory, Expenses, Clients, Production, Reports
problem: Six core screens use hard-coded arrays and React state; nothing is saved. Data disappears on refresh, and Add buttons on Expenses/Clients/Reports export do nothing.
evidence: Orders.js:22-74,94-130; Inventory.js:20-91,111-144; Expenses.js:7-20,104,141; Clients.js:7-19,64,124; Production.js:22-87; Reports.js:7-35,64,107,131,155. 47 of 80 api.js methods unused (ordersAPI, inventoryAPI, financeAPI, clientsAPI, reportsAPI, productionAPI...)
impact: The ERP cannot record a single real order, stock item, expense or client from its UI. The working backend is unreachable for users.
root_cause: Frontend built on mock data first; API integration never completed.
fix: Wire each screen to its existing api.js client and backend service; add loading/error states; delete mock arrays.

problem: Any logged-in user can read Employees, Attendance, Orders, Inventory, Clients and Finance rows through the page-builder data-source endpoints, bypassing area permissions.
evidence: page-builder-service/server.js GET /datasources/:key/rows and /aggregate (no permission check); gateway maps builder to login-only (gateway/server.js:35). Runtime RT-065: orders-only user got 200 with employee and attendance rows while /api/attendance returned 403
impact: Personal data (employee records, attendance) exposed to every account — DPDP Act exposure.
root_cause: Data sources added for page authoring without per-source authorisation.
fix: Map each data source to the area permission that owns it (employees→payroll, attendance→attendance, …) and enforce it on rows/aggregate/columns; restrict custom pages to the sources their viewers may see.

problem: Services check only that a token is valid, not the area permission; they listen on all interfaces. Anyone with any valid token can call a service port directly and read data (e.g. payroll).
evidence: shared/auth.js:70-76 (protectService authenticates only); app.listen(PORT) without host in every service; Runtime RT-052: orders-only token → 200 with employee salary data on payroll port
impact: Salary and personal data readable by any employee who can reach the server ports.
root_cause: Authorisation implemented only in the gateway; services trust the network.
fix: Enforce requirePermission inside each service (same map as gateway) and bind services to 127.0.0.1 / private network; firewall service ports.

problem: "Mark Paid" sets the payroll's allowances and deductions to 0 and does not mark it paid (no status column; status hard-coded "pending").
evidence: Payroll.js:92 sends {status:"paid"}; payroll-service PUT /payrolls/:id writes allowances||0, deductions||0; postgres/01-core-setup.sql Payrolls has no Status; Runtime RT-066
impact: Salaries silently change when HR marks them paid; no record of what was paid.
root_cause: Frontend and API contract never agreed; payroll has no lifecycle.
fix: Add Status (pending/approved/paid) + PaidAt/PaidBy; PUT updates only supplied fields; separate /payrolls/:id/pay action.

problem: Server accepts negative stock, negative order amounts, invalid order statuses, delivery before order date, negative production, negative deductions that inflate pay, and payroll month "banana".
evidence: Runtime RT-015, RT-019, RT-020, RT-021, RT-031, RT-039, RT-040; order-service, inventory-service, production-planning-service, payroll-service validate only names
impact: Financial and stock figures can be corrupted by typos; pay can be inflated without trace.
root_cause: No server-side validation layer or database CHECK constraints.
fix: Add request validation (schema per endpoint) and DB CHECK constraints (quantity>=0, amount>=0, status IN (...), month format).

problem: Invoices are wrong and not stored: GST layout shows CGST 2.5% + SGST 2.5% but totals use 8%; invoice number generated once per page load (duplicates); invoices saved only in the browser and never read; "total in words" prints digits.
evidence: OrderWorkflow/InvoiceGenerator.js:80, 139-145, 153-164, 263-265, 279, 285-288
impact: Issuing these invoices would breach GST rules (incorrect tax, non-unique numbers) and leave no records.
root_cause: Invoice designer built as a front-end prototype without a backend or tax engine.
fix: Do not use for customers until rebuilt: backend invoice table with sequential numbering per financial year, GST computed from HSN/place of supply, persisted line items.

problem: Real-looking third-party business identifiers are hard-coded in source: company names, addresses, GSTIN, phone, email, bank account, IFSC, e-way bill numbers; same buyer GSTIN for every client.
evidence: InvoiceGenerator.js:179-191, 226, 234, 296-299; TemplateBuilder/TemplateBuilder.js:7-15, 26-40, 59-62; TemplateList/TemplateList.js:111-122, 243-246 (values deliberately not reproduced in this report)
impact: Third-party personal/financial data distributed with the code; risk under DPDP Act and confidentiality.
root_cause: Sample data copied from a real invoice.
fix: Replace with clearly fictional placeholders now; move seller details to configuration stored server-side; review git history for exposure.

module: Style Costing, Planning Dashboard, Quality Dashboard, Worker Dashboard
problem: Four routed screens call service ports directly without the login token (and Style Costing uses wrong paths), so they always show empty data — "No tasks", "All caught up".
evidence: StyleCosting.js:31,43,55,67,86 (/costing/* paths do not exist); ProductionPlanning/PlanningDashboard.js:26,38,51; QualityManagement/QualityDashboard.js:25,38; ProductionWorkflow/ProductionWorkerDashboard.js:22,36
impact: Costing, production planning and quality modules are unusable from the UI although their backends work (101-endpoint smoke test).
fix: Use costingAPI / productionAPI / qualityAPI from services/api.js; surface errors instead of empty states.

problem: Machine allocation sends null IDs (reads MachineID/OrderID that the views do not return) and reports success even when the procedure returns Result=Error.
evidence: PlanningDashboard.js:238, 355; production-planning-service/server.js POST /machines/allocate returns success:true regardless; postgres/02-production-planning.sql vw_MachineStatus, vw_ProductionOverview
impact: Planners believe machines are allocated when they are not.
root_cause: View columns and UI expectations diverged; business errors returned as rows with HTTP 200.
fix: Add MachineID/OrderID to the views; return 409 when Result=Error; show the message.

problem: Production can exceed target and order quantity without limit (5,080 pieces on a 120-piece task, 5,080 of 1,000 on the order); order status never changes to Completed.
evidence: postgres/02-production-planning.sql sp_RecordProduction (no bound checks, no status transition); Runtime RT-028, RT-029, RT-045
impact: Over-reporting inflates output and efficiency; orders never close.
root_cause: No business rules in the recording procedure.
fix: Reject pieces > remaining (or require supervisor override); auto-set ProductionOrders.Status when CompletedQuantity >= TotalQuantity.

problem: Production report and employee-performance endpoints crash (HTTP 500 numeric field overflow) once efficiency passes 999.99%.
evidence: report-service/server.js GET /reports/production and production-planning-service GET /planning/employee-performance cast to DECIMAL(5,2); Runtime RT-034 (+ direct check: both 500)
impact: One mis-recorded batch takes reporting down for everyone.
fix: Widen to DECIMAL(9,2) or NUMERIC; fix F-011; catch and report data anomalies.

problem: Orders are isolated: no order lines or products, no link to clients (free-text name), stock is not reserved or deducted, no receivable or revenue is recorded.
evidence: postgres/04-erp-core.sql Orders (ClientName text, no items); Runtime RT-017, RT-018, RT-023
impact: Sales, stock and money cannot be reconciled; every figure must be re-entered elsewhere.
root_cause: Modules designed as independent CRUD tables.
fix: Introduce order lines referencing items and clients; reserve/deduct stock on confirm/dispatch; create invoice/receivable on invoice.

problem: Production consumes no raw material and creates no finished goods; costing materials (Materials) and stock (InventoryItems) are separate, unlinked masters.
evidence: Runtime RT-030; postgres/03-style-costing.sql Materials vs postgres/04-erp-core.sql InventoryItems
impact: Stock levels and production cost are never accurate.
fix: Unify item master; use StyleCostings as BOM; post consumption and finished-goods receipts from production records.

problem: Inventory has no unit cost, SKU, warehouse/location or movement history, so stock value cannot be computed (the reference scenario value of 85,625 cannot be reproduced).
evidence: postgres/04-erp-core.sql InventoryItems; Runtime RT-014 (unitPrice silently discarded), RT-006 (no warehouses)
impact: No inventory valuation for accounts, insurance or management.
fix: Add cost, SKU (unique), location, and a StockMovements ledger (receipt/issue/adjustment) with valuation method (weighted average).

problem: Purchase orders, goods receipt and supplier management exist only as a browser-storage demo with wrong maths (fixed "$10/unit", qty 0 becomes full receipt, negatives allowed, partial receipt closes PO).
evidence: InventoryWorkflow/StockChecker.js:33-49; PurchaseOrders.js:34-36; GoodsReceiving.js:21-54 (line 27, 41); Runtime RT-008, RT-009 (no backend)
impact: Purchasing cannot be run in the ERP.
fix: Build suppliers, purchase orders, approvals and goods-receipt in the backend; post receipts to stock ledger (F-015).

problem: Finance is a flat list of income/expense rows: no chart of accounts, receivables, payables, bank, GST, or links to orders, purchases or payroll; no currency/tax settings.
evidence: postgres/04-erp-core.sql FinanceTransactions; finance-service/server.js (3 endpoints); Runtime RT-007
impact: Cannot produce statutory accounts, GST returns or receivable ageing.
fix: Either integrate an accounting package (Tally/Zoho Books export) or build AR/AP + GL postings with GST.

problem: Payroll ignores attendance (absent day not deducted) and has no statutory components (PF, ESI, PT, TDS), leave, approval or payslips.
evidence: Runtime RT-038; payroll-service/server.js; postgres/01-core-setup.sql Payrolls
impact: Payroll must still be computed outside the system.
fix: Compute pay from attendance and salary structure; add statutory deductions, approval and payslip PDF.

problem: Editing an employee erases the joining date (UI reads JoiningDate, API returns joiningDate) and a partial update returns 500 because PUT overwrites every column.
evidence: Payroll.js:66, 183; payroll-service/server.js PUT /employees/:id (:117-124); Runtime RT-041 (500, NOT NULL on email)
impact: Employee master data degrades every time it is edited.
fix: Use joiningDate; switch to COALESCE partial updates with 404 for unknown id.

problem: Total sales includes cancelled orders; "Top products" is production quantity × material cost, not sales.
evidence: report-service/server.js GET /reports/sales; Runtime RT-046, RT-047
impact: Sales performance overstated; product ranking misleading.
root_cause: Report SQL lacks status filters; no sales line data exists (F-013).
fix: Exclude cancelled/rejected orders; base product ranking on order lines once F-013 exists; label the current metric honestly until then.

problem: A wrong password reloads the page instead of showing "Invalid credentials" (401 interceptor reloads unless the path starts with /login, but the login screen is mounted at "*").
evidence: services/api.js:40-51; App.js:78
impact: Users cannot tell why login failed.
fix: Skip the reload for the login request itself (check request URL) or mount login at /login.

problem: Logout leaves the JWT in localStorage; deactivated users keep access for up to 24 h; no brute-force protection on login.
evidence: App.js:63-66; Runtime RT-056 (deactivated token → 200), RT-058 (25 wrong passwords, no throttling)
impact: Shared computers stay logged in; dismissed staff retain access; password guessing is unlimited.
root_cause: Stateless JWT without revocation or rate limiting.
fix: clearSession() on logout; check IsActive (or a token version) per request at the gateway; add rate limiting/lockout on /login and /signup.

problem: Orders screen crashes after editing an order and expanding it (quantity/unitPrice become strings, then .toFixed throws); no error boundary.
evidence: Orders.js:101, 428
impact: Users lose the screen until reload.
root_cause: Form values not converted on edit.
fix: Convert numbers on edit; add an app-level error boundary. (Superseded once F-002 rewires the screen.)

problem: Re-running setup-database.js (or any schema file) drops and recreates tables and wipes business data; there is no migration tool or versioning.
evidence: postgres/01..07 begin with DROP TABLE ... CASCADE; setup-database.js applies all files
impact: One wrong command deletes the company's data.
root_cause: Schema files are bootstrap scripts, not migrations.
fix: Freeze current schema as baseline; adopt versioned migrations (node-pg-migrate or similar); make setup refuse to run on a non-empty database without --force.

problem: No backup, restore or disaster-recovery procedure exists.
evidence: Repository: no backup scripts, docs or scheduled jobs
impact: Hardware failure or mistake means permanent data loss.
fix: Scheduled pg_dump with retention + restore drill; document RPO/RTO.

problem: No backend tests, no CI pipeline; the only original frontend test is the Create React App placeholder and it fails (cannot resolve react-router-dom, expects "learn react").
evidence: smarterpfrontend/src/App.test.js; npm test result: 1 suite failed; no .github/ or pipeline files; backend package.json has no test script
impact: Regressions (like F-005) ship unnoticed.
fix: Add API integration tests against a disposable database (the evidence/runtime-audit.js harness is a starting point) and run them in CI with frontend unit tests.

problem: No audit trail: nobody can see who changed a salary, stock quantity, order or permission, or when.
evidence: No audit tables or triggers in postgres/*.sql; services log only to console
impact: Fraud or mistakes cannot be investigated; weak for ISO 27001 / SOC 2.
fix: Add an AuditLog table written by services (actor, entity, before/after, timestamp) for financial, HR and permission changes.

problem: No quotations, sales invoices (server-side), payments, shipments, returns or refunds.
evidence: Runtime RT-023; no corresponding tables in postgres/*.sql
impact: Order-to-cash process cannot be completed.
fix: Build quotation → order → dispatch → invoice → payment with status workflow (depends on F-013, F-017).

problem: Eight routes open for any logged-in user regardless of permissions: /workflows, /permissions, /roles, /templates, /planning-dashboard, /worker-dashboard, /quality-dashboard, /p/:pageKey (including inactive pages).
evidence: App.js:104, 111-113, 117-119, 123; page-builder-service GET /pages/:pageKey (no status/permission check)
impact: Users reach screens and unpublished pages they should not see.
fix: Wrap in RequirePermission (dashboards → production); hide inactive pages from non-authors; remove demo routes.

module: Roles / Permissions / API Manager / Form Rules / Workflows
problem: Five settings screens are browser-only demos with no effect: Roles and Permissions conflict with the real User Management; API Manager lists fake endpoints; Form Rules and Workflows are never applied.
evidence: ApplicationSettings/Roles.js, Permissions.js (localStorage); ApiManager.js:16-53; FormRules.js:16-53; Workflows/Workflows.js
impact: Admins think they changed access or rules when nothing happened.
fix: Remove or clearly label as "preview"; point to User Management for access control.

problem: Templates screen crashes when TemplateBuilder or TemplateList have saved templates (three record shapes share one browser key); template variables are never substituted; "Use this template" does not navigate.
evidence: ApplicationSettings/Templates.js:216, 222; TemplateBuilder.js:130-140; TemplateList.js:64-67, 95
impact: Template features unusable.
root_cause: Three independent prototypes share one key.
fix: Consolidate into one server-backed template model, or remove until invoicing is rebuilt (F-007).

problem: Currency is shown as "$" across the application for an Indian business (INR); invoice formats mix $ and ₹; dates use en-US.
evidence: Dashboard.js, Orders.js, Inventory.js, Expenses.js, Payroll.js:131,184-185,242-245, StyleCosting.js, InvoiceGenerator.js (agent evidence)
impact: Reports look foreign and confuse users; risk of wrong currency on documents.
fix: Central formatter (₹, en-IN grouping, IST dates) driven by an organisation setting.

problem: Default dates are wrong in India between 00:00–05:30 (today() uses UTC) and the "month to date" filter starts on the last day of the previous month.
evidence: Attendance/Attendance.js:6, 9
impact: Early-morning users see yesterday; monthly summaries include an extra day.
fix: Format dates in Asia/Kolkata (Intl API), as the backend already does (shared/app-time.js).

problem: Double-clicking Save creates duplicate records (no idempotency); concurrent employee creation fails with 500 because codes are COUNT(*)+1.
evidence: Runtime RT-022 (2 orders); concurrent POST /payroll/employees: 1 ok, 3 × 500 duplicate EmployeeCode (sp_CreateEmployee, postgres/01-core-setup.sql)
impact: Duplicates and intermittent failures when several people work at once.
root_cause: No idempotency keys; code from row count.
fix: Disable submit while saving and accept an Idempotency-Key; generate codes from a sequence.

problem: Payroll KPIs are mislabelled: "Total CTC" is base×12 (ignores CTC), "Pending Payrolls" counts last month's processed payrolls, "Total Employees" includes inactive staff while the list shows active only.
evidence: payroll-service/server.js GET /stats (:322-326)
impact: HR cost figures differ from the employee records.
fix: Use SUM(CTC), status-based pending count (needs F-005), and consistent active filter.

problem: Inconsistent error handling: over-length input and negative limits return 500; gateway returns 500 with the raw upstream error when a service is down; no proxy timeout; business errors returned as HTTP 200.
evidence: Runtime RT-061, RT-063; gateway/server.js:107-111; production-planning-service allocate
impact: Users see "Failed" with no reason; internal details leak.
fix: Shared error handler mapping validation→400, conflicts→409, upstream down→503 with generic text; set proxy and DB statement timeouts.

problem: CORS allows any origin; no security headers (helmet/CSP); JWT kept in localStorage (readable by any injected script); JWT verify does not pin the algorithm.
evidence: gateway/server.js:9 and every service app.use(cors()); services/api.js:12; shared/auth.js:23-32
impact: Raises the impact of any future XSS bug to full account takeover.
fix: Restrict CORS to the app origin; add helmet with CSP; pin algorithms:["HS256"]; consider httpOnly cookies.

problem: Logs contain personal data: the gateway logs user e-mail on 403 and auth-service logs every request URL.
evidence: gateway/server.js:92; auth-service/server.js:41-44
impact: Personal data in plain-text logs (DPDP).
fix: Log user id only; structured logs without query strings containing PII.

problem: No pagination or filtering on list endpoints (orders, inventory, payrolls, attendance, users, pages...).
evidence: Agent C endpoint review; only page-builder rows has a cap (500)
impact: Screens slow down and memory grows as data accumulates.
fix: Add limit/offset (or keyset) + server-side filters and sort to list endpoints.

problem: Foreign-key columns are not indexed; business tables lack CHECK constraints and natural unique keys (e.g. one payroll per employee per month).
evidence: postgres/02-production-planning.sql, 03, 01 (Payrolls), 04: only 6 indexes in the whole schema
impact: Slower joins as data grows; duplicates and invalid states possible (supports F-006).
fix: Index FK columns; add CHECKs and UNIQUE(EmployeeID, Month).

problem: Forms can be designed and placed on pages, but submissions are never stored ("Captured (not yet persisted)").
evidence: pagebuilder/PageRenderer.js FormFields onSubmit
impact: Forms collect nothing.
fix: Add FormSubmissions table + endpoint + list/export screen; validate against the form definition server-side.

problem: Screens are opened with the menu-manager / form-builder permission but saving requires page-builder, so those users get 403 on every save.
evidence: page-builder-service/server.js canAuthor (requirePermission page-builder) on /menus, /pages; App.js routes
impact: Delegated admins cannot do their job.
root_cause: One permission reused for three tools.
fix: Accept the screen's own permission on its write routes.

problem: Editing an Admin stores every permission key for that user, which become effective if the user is later demoted; self-demotion is allowed; permission save is not transactional.
evidence: UserManagement.js:85, 161; auth-service/server.js savePermissions (DELETE then INSERTs)
impact: Demoted admins may keep broad access.
fix: Do not persist permissions for Admin role; block self-demotion of the last admin; wrap save in a transaction.

problem: Inspection totals are not validated (approved + rejected may differ from inspected); /quality/inspect is not transactional; inspector is hard-coded to employee 1 in the UI.
evidence: Runtime RT-033; production-planning-service POST /quality/inspect; QualityDashboard.js:43
impact: Quality statistics unreliable; wrong inspector recorded.
fix: Validate sums server-side; use the transaction path; take inspector from the logged-in user.

problem: A machine allocation can never be ended, so machines stay "Occupied" forever; no rescheduling.
evidence: production-planning-service/server.js (no endpoint updates MachineAllocations.Status or frees Machines.Status)
impact: Machine availability degrades to zero over time.
fix: Add release/complete allocation endpoint that frees the machine.

problem: No structured logging, metrics, health dashboard or alerting; no deployment configuration (Docker, process manager, HTTPS).
evidence: console.log only; no Dockerfile / compose / pm2 config / CI in repository
impact: Outages go unnoticed; deployments are manual and unrepeatable.
fix: Process manager + reverse proxy with TLS; structured logs; uptime and error alerts.

problem: No export (PDF/Excel) — the four "Export PDF" buttons do nothing; no data import (Runtime RT-010).
evidence: Reports.js:64, 107, 131, 155; Runtime RT-010
impact: Data must be retyped into spreadsheets.
fix: CSV/Excel export on list endpoints; CSV import for items, clients, employees with validation report.

problem: Production workflow tabs are disconnected: Order Review is always empty (no code produces Confirmed/Invoiced orders), Material Check always reports full shortage (stale state), scheduler invents quantity 100 and writes batches nothing reads.
evidence: ProductionWorkflow/OrderReview.js:9-13; MaterialCheck.js:11, 34; ProductionScheduler.js:55, 68-69
impact: Production workflow cannot be completed in the UI.
fix: Replace with production-planning backend (orders, allocation, tasks) — see F-009, F-014.

problem: "Today" and default dates use the UTC calendar day, so work recorded between 00:00 and 05:30 IST is filed under the previous day (production date, transaction date, order date, "today's" dashboard figures); month-end income can land in the wrong month.
evidence: shared/database.js sets session TimeZone=UTC; CURRENT_DATE defaults in postgres/02, 04; WHERE ProductionDate = CURRENT_DATE in production-planning-service /planning/summary, /quality/dashboard; finance-service POST uses CURRENT_DATE
impact: Daily and monthly figures shift between days around midnight IST.
root_cause: Attendance derives the IST date in the application, other modules do not.
fix: Pass the business date (APP_TIMEZONE) from the application as attendance does, or set the session time zone to the organisation's zone for date defaults.

problem: Dead and legacy code: retired production-service (empty routes folder), shared/init-db.js and shared/production-schema.js (SQL Server DDL), backend test-*.js scripts for SQL Server, unrouted ProductionPlanning.js and QualityManagement.js, unused CreateOrder, start:production script.
evidence: smarterpbackend/services/production-service/, shared/init-db.js, shared/production-schema.js, smarterpbackend/test-*.js, package.json start:production
impact: Confuses developers; risk of someone running obsolete code.
fix: Delete or move to an archive folder after confirming nothing imports them.

problem: Single-organisation design: no company/branch dimension, no multi-currency, no localisation framework.
evidence: No OrganizationID/BranchID in any table (postgres/*.sql)
impact: Cannot serve groups with several companies or branches.
fix: Decide on tenancy model before data grows; add Company/Branch to masters and transactions if required.

problem: No notifications (email/WhatsApp/in-app) for low stock, approvals, payroll or late attendance; no mobile-friendly worker screens verified.
evidence: No notification code in repository
impact: Staff must poll screens.
fix: Event hooks + notification service once core workflows exist.
